_comment: QUOTAS 10 and REPORTING-EXTENSIONS 11 cases, written by spec/tools/quota_estimate.py --write.

fingerprints.why: resets 19 h apart while both live: two accounts (seen 2026-11-11)
next instance of one account does not overlap: no pair
instances touching within a minute of jitter: no pair
observed only after `at`: the first pair after it decides
a confirmation and a contradiction observed at the same time: the contradiction
the latest pair decides: an old contradiction, then a confirmation

inferPlan.why: a weekly window and no 5-hour window: Ultra (some Ultra accounts lost the 5-hour window, user 2026-11-10)
a 5-hour window and no anchor: unknown
a quarter of a Max 20x account's 5-hour cap: Max 5x
half of it, between Max 5x and Max 20x: unknown
own estimate of low confidence: unknown
the anchor of low confidence is skipped; a Pro anchor of any tier counts as 1
an anchor of another plan has no multiplier

segments.name: cumulative runs, lag and integer resolution
0.1 resolution and increments; a cumulative lower bound above an increment keeps the increments
five-hour window on a whole hour: start slack for the upper bound
modelWeek counts only its model family

vote.name: a lower bound outweighs three contaminated uppers
five contaminated uppers outweigh a lower bound
tie in loss: most weight inside wins

estimate.name: two narrow windows agree: high, range widened to 2 %
a contaminated window below a clean one
region below a lower bound is never high
a lowered cap: two agreeing windows drop older ones above them

cases.name: five-hour after reset, no use yet

ledger.name: priced, unpriced and cloud responses
ledger.why: C- counts whole minutes inside, C+ every minute touched; the unpriced response's 500 tokens cost the highest priced rate (Opus, 9000 micro-USD per token); a Bedrock route is left out; modelWeek Fable counts only claude-fable-*

ledger.name: unpriced only
ledger.why: with no priced model the upper bound is unbounded (null)

ledger.name: other Codex provider
ledger.why: a response whose model_provider is not openai is no subscription spend

chains.name: two accounts switching
chains.why: account A's two 5h instances share one weekly instance, so they are one chain; account B's lines name other instances and start after codex login gives B's key; A never seen live keeps a chain key of its own; a response with no token count line (API key) and one whose line comes 6 s later are left out

claude.name: Desktop on a personal plan
claude.why: same organization and a personal plan: Desktop spends on the CLI's account, sources list both, the two spends add up

claude.name: Desktop on a team plan
claude.why: a team organization is shared by its members: Desktop keeps its own account (no plan, account class)

claude.name: Desktop on another account of the organization
claude.why: same organization and a personal plan, but the 7-day resets lie 19 h apart while both instances are live: two accounts (seen 2026-11-11), Desktop keeps its own

claude.name: Desktop without CLI values
claude.why: no CLI window to compare: the fingerprint is unknown and Desktop keeps its own account

claude.name: Desktop's value before the CLI's
claude.why: Desktop's snapshot comes before any CLI value: the first comparable pair after it decides, so Desktop's earlier spend joins the CLI's account

inference.name: Desktop without a 5-hour window
inference.why: Desktop's own account shows a weekly window and no 5-hour window: claude_ultra (some Ultra accounts lost the 5-hour window, user 2026-11-10); the Fable window of the account carries it too

inference.name: Desktop of a team organization
inference.why: the CLI names Desktop's organization a team one: nothing is inferred

inference.name: Desktop at a quarter of the CLI's 5-hour cap
inference.why: the CLI's Max 20x account caps 5 h at ≈ $95 and Desktop's own account at ≈ $23 (both medium): 20 · 23.4 / 94.9 ≈ 4.9, claude_max with default_claude_max_5x

inference.name: Desktop at half the CLI's 5-hour cap
inference.why: 20 · 46.8 / 94.9 ≈ 9.9 lies more than 1.5 times away from 5 and from 20: nothing is inferred

keys.name: spend before the first key and a /login
keys.why: the response before the first key seen goes to that key; after the switch spend goes to the new key

classes.name: two accounts, one plan
classes.why: both accounts' instances pool in the class (openai/pro, 5h): two windows

classes.name: null plan_type
classes.why: lines with a null plan take the account's nearest earlier plan, else its first later one (account A is plus throughout); account Z never names a plan and keeps an account class

loweredCap.name: lowered cap
loweredCap.why: three windows at $100 then two at $60: the instances after the cut fall below the older ones' lower bounds, so the older evidence is dropped and the estimate is $60 (a last zero-cost turn with the same percent lets the cumulative bound count the final response)

planChange.name: plan change inside a window
planChange.why: the instance splits at the change: the plus part stays in the plus class, the pro part starts the pro class; the entry shows the newer part

live.name: five-hour after reset, no use yet
live.why: after R with no local response yet: 0 %, not estimated, no reset

live.name: five-hour after reset, after the first response
live.why: the new instance starts at the minute of the first local response's start after R (R + 38 min), resets 5 h later; the percent is spend since then over the cap

live.name: weekly after reset
live.why: a weekly window restarts at R + n * minutes: 1.5 weeks after R that is R + 1 week, so the response 3 days after R no longer counts

live.name: before the reset
live.why: spend after the newest vendor value raises the live percent: p + 100 * (C+(S, now) - C+(S, t)) / K, estimated from 0.5 points up

store.name: store written
store.why: runs of equal values keep their first and last observation; key changes are kept with their plan

store.name: store read back
store.why: a later launch with only the responses and the stored file gives the same estimate: the stored keys attribute the spend, the stored observations rebuild the instance

store.name: store limits
store.why: 300 distinct values of one instance thin to 256 evenly spaced runs (first and last kept); 70 closed instances of one class keep the newest 64; generated store: observation i = 1..300 of k1 (claudeCode, sevenDay, plan claude_max) at t = tLo = t0 + i min with p = i / 10 and R = t0 + 6 d; closed instance i = 1..70 of class (plan, anthropic/claude_max, null, fiveHour::300) with R = t0 - 5 i h, lo 1e8, hi 2e8, pMax 40, tLast = R - 1 h; one key

store.name: store of another version
store.why: a file of another version is ignored (and replaced); the same generated store with version 1 (before the fixed account salt)

store.name: store written with Desktop
store.why: Desktop's stored timeline holds its organization's own key; the shared key is derived

store.name: store read back with Desktop
store.why: only the responses and the stored file: the stored organization timeline and the stored windows of both sources give the same merge and estimate

report.name: entries and their order
report.why: Codex first, then the Claude account, then the team Desktop account; each account's windows unnamed by length, then named; percent at two decimals, micro-USD whole; a Desktop of a team organization lists itself only

report.name: two Codex accounts
report.why: two accounts of one source and window are two entries with the same sources and window and different account tags (seen 2026-11-11: a service rejected the pair before the tag existed)

cadence.why: a report carries `quotas` when it is the run's first, the set of entries, a vendor percent, a confidence or the reset state changed, 60 s passed since the last sent one, or the app leaves; spend alone waits; a section dropped for size counts as unsent; switching the section off sends `[]` once; a new run starts empty
